headline: Lech Mountain Mirror / Snøhetta
context: In the Lech mountain region in Austria, Snøhetta has designed a landscape installation on the roof of the Zugerbergbahn's mountain station. The art intervention plays with visitors' perceptions and reinforces Lech's status as a year-round destination.
